objective: Make Public Wall fullscreen video viewer visually clean, resilient, faster on swipe and automatic playback, correcting mojibake without sacrificing signed-media access, native ads or existing videos.
scope: Android Expo JS OTA candidate only; no independent production push, no new native dependencies.

viewer: Remove automatic signed-URL refresh on fullscreen open and each swipe; reuse latest playable URL including Wall already-refreshed URLs.
Viewport activation at 60% and 80 ms, measured modal page size, bounded single next video preload.
Dedupe failed video URL refresh, cap at 3 attempts per opened viewer, 2500 ms backoff, ignore stale results across close/reopen sessions.
Protect top status bar, reduce fullscreen bottom interaction panel, suppress oversized Recent comment preview while preserving normal feed default.
Show a short non-overlapping swipe hint, remove unnecessary load-more banners except when pagination genuinely errors, fix literal Refreshing videoâ€¦ mojibake.
sharedPlayer: Keep Expo-video cached media, post-scoped playback resume, paused offscreen players and existing IMA monetization branch.
Render fullscreen loading badge beneath safe area.
Defer thumbnail extraction until 1500ms after actual visible playback to avoid first-frame decoder startup competition; cancel timers on pause, URI change and unmount.
